subject: general
question: Who led the Congress in the second round table conference held in London?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** led the Congress delegation in the **second round table conference** held in **London**.
 
• The second round table conference took place from **7th September 1931 to 1st December 1931**.
 
• This conference aimed to discuss constitutional reforms in India and included representatives from various Indian political and social groups.
 
• **Gandhi represented the Indian National Congress and was the sole representative of the Congress at this conference**.
 
• The conference, however, did not result in any significant progress towards Indian self-rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **first round table conference** was held from **November 1930 to January 1931**, and the **third round table conference** was held from **November to December 1932**.
 
• The round table conferences were a series of peace conferences organized by the British Government to discuss constitutional reforms in India.
 
• The **Government of India Act 1935** was eventually passed, incorporating some of the discussions from these conferences.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi's participation in the second round table conference was significant as it marked his first and only visit to London after the start of the freedom struggle in India.
